title: Claude Code AI + Unreal Engine 5 = Atomic Battlegrounds
author: West_Discussion5928
selftext:
I have been working on this game using Claude Code and Unreal Engine 5 connected via MCP.

More info: [https://www.bombermanboard.com/viewtopic.php?t=2495](https://www.bombermanboard.com/viewtopic.php?t=2495)  
Video: [https://youtu.be/q6HntgeOuhk](https://youtu.be/q6HntgeOuhk)

What do you think?

comments.author: West_Discussion5928
comments.body: Any feedback is appreciated and welcome :)

comments.author: mggriebz
comments.body:
Cool idea, instantly got bomberman vibes and could see how a quick fun game loop would be.

Maybe a level editor or something to help make it more sandbox like with different maps, but overall don’t have much feedback, looks good.

replies.author: West_Discussion5928
replies.body: Thank you for the feedback :). Yes, a level and gamemode editor is planed. Currently I am working on the character editor so people can make and share their own pawns.

comments.author: West_Discussion5928
comments.body: Character editor has been added, Alpha 8 released
